application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: TPO 614 T6 & T7 2x Oak to fell.
decision_conditions: The trees are located to the rear of 9 and 11 Rushdene Road, Eastcote. The mature oak's appear to be in good condition and positively contribute to the arboreal nature of the area. The trees can be viewed from neighboring properties and are partially visible from Rushdene Road. The condition and stature of the trees give them a high amenity value.

This application has been refused, as the proposed removal of both trees is considered disproportionate at this stage. Evidence suggests that other vegetation located closer to the affected structure may be contributing to the observed ground movement, and this has not yet been fully addressed.

At present, two seasons of level monitoring data have been submitted, which indicate a pattern of seasonal movement. However, this data is insufficient to conclusively demonstrate that the subject trees are the primary cause, particularly given the presence of nearer vegetation.
Should further level monitoring be carried out following the removal or
The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.
